svg.title: The walk from L[0][0] to the far corner of the table for ABCABBA and CBABAC, and the edit script it reads off, printed as hunks
svg.text: at 06.02: the table, then the walk

g.title: At (0, 0), L 4: "A" is not "C". Below 4, right 4: a tie, and a tie deletes: step down, deleting a's "A".
g.text: trace: walk: at 0 0, L 4: delete "A": below 4 >= right 4

g.title: At (1, 0), L 4: "B" is not "C". Below 4, right 4: a tie, and a tie deletes: step down, deleting a's "B".
g.text: trace: walk: at 1 0, L 4: delete "B": below 4 >= right 4

g.title: At (2, 0), L 4: a's line 2 and b's line 0 are both "C": keep it, and step to the lower right.
At (3, 1), L 3: "A" is not "B". Below 3, right 3: a tie, and a tie deletes: step down, deleting a's "A".
g.text: trace: walk: at 3 1, L 3: delete "A": below 3 >= right 3

g.title: At (4, 1), L 3: a's line 4 and b's line 1 are both "B": keep it, and step to the lower right.
At (5, 2), L 2: "B" is not "A". Below 1, right 2: right holds more in common, so step right, inserting b's "A".
g.text: trace: walk: at 5 2, L 2: insert "A": below 1 < right 2

g.title: At (5, 3), L 2: a's line 5 and b's line 3 are both "B": keep it, and step to the lower right.
At (6, 4), L 1: a's line 6 and b's line 4 are both "A": keep it, and step to the lower right.
At (7, 5): a is done, so what is left of b is inserted: "C". The walk is at the corner.
g.text: trace: walk: at 7 5, L 0: insert "C": a is done

g.title: bin/diff a.txt b.txt: with 3 lines of context the changes are never more than 6 unchanged lines apart, so the whole script is one hunk, edits 0 to 8: 7 lines of a from line 1, 6 of b from line 1.
bin/diff -U0 a.txt b.txt: no context, so every run of changes is a hunk of its own, 4 of them. A count of 0 names the line before: +1,0 is no lines of b, just after b's line 1.
g.text: trace: hunk: edits 0 to 1, then edits 3 to 3, then edits 5 to 5, then edits 8 to 8
